name: Tajima Shizuka
source:
A teacher in the school Yukinojou transferred to. He is in charge of educational guidance and various sports classes, a sworn enemy of Serina.

He has a heinous face, merciless personality, and villainous behavior... the worst PE teacher ever. Serina and co gave him the nickname "Sadistic Shizuka". Wherever he goes, tears of innocent students are spilled in his wake.
